verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.77
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.77

verses.pali: 8. Yodhājīvavagga
verses.english: 8. Warriors

verses.pali: Paṭhamaanāgatabhayasutta
verses.english: Future Perils (1st)

verses.pali: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, seeing these five future perils is quite enough for a wilderness mendicant to meditate diligently, keenly, and resolutely for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.

verses.pali: Katamāni pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
verses.english: Firstly, a wilderness mendicant reflects:

verses.pali: ‘ahaṁ kho etarahi ekako araññe viharāmi.
verses.english: ‘Currently I’m living alone in a wilderness.

verses.pali: Ekakaṁ kho pana maṁ araññe viharantaṁ
verses.english: While living here alone

verses.pali: ahi vā maṁ ḍaṁseyya, vicchiko vā maṁ ḍaṁseyya, satapadī vā maṁ ḍaṁseyya,
verses.english: I might get bitten by a snake, a scorpion, or a centipede.

verses.pali: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
verses.english: And if I died from that it would be an obstacle to my progress.

verses.pali: handāhaṁ vīriyaṁ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
verses.english: I’d better rouse up energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.’

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṁ anāgatabhayaṁ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
verses.english: This is the first future peril …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
verses.english: Furthermore, a wilderness mendicant reflects:

verses.pali: ‘ahaṁ kho etarahi ekako araññe viharāmi.
verses.english: ‘Currently I’m living alone in a wilderness.

verses.pali: Ekako kho panāhaṁ araññe viharanto
verses.english: While living here alone

verses.pali: upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṁ, bhattaṁ vā bhuttaṁ me byāpajjeyya, pittaṁ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṁ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṁ,
verses.english: I might stumble off a cliff, or get food poisoning, or suffer a disturbance of bile, phlegm, or piercing winds.

verses.pali: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
verses.english: And if I died from that it would be an obstacle to my progress.

verses.pali: handāhaṁ vīriyaṁ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
verses.english: I’d better rouse up energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.’

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṁ anāgatabhayaṁ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
verses.english: This is the second future peril …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
verses.english: Furthermore, a wilderness mendicant reflects:

verses.pali: ‘ahaṁ kho etarahi ekako araññe viharāmi.
verses.english: ‘Currently I’m living alone in a wilderness.

verses.pali: Ekako kho panāhaṁ araññe viharanto
verses.english: While living here alone

verses.pali: vāḷehi samāgaccheyyaṁ, sīhena vā byagghena vā dīpinā vā acchena vā taracchena vā, te maṁ jīvitā voropeyyuṁ,
verses.english: I might encounter wild beasts—a lion, a tiger, a leopard, a bear, or a hyena—which might take my life.

verses.pali: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
verses.english: And if I died from that it would be an obstacle to my progress.

verses.pali: handāhaṁ vīriyaṁ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
verses.english: I’d better rouse up energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.’

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṁ anāgatabhayaṁ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
verses.english: This is the third future peril …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
verses.english: Furthermore, a wilderness mendicant reflects:

verses.pali: ‘ahaṁ kho etarahi ekako araññe viharāmi.
verses.english: ‘Currently I’m living alone in a wilderness.

verses.pali: Ekako kho panāhaṁ araññe viharanto
verses.english: While living here alone

verses.pali: māṇavehi samāgaccheyyaṁ katakammehi vā akatakammehi vā, te maṁ jīvitā voropeyyuṁ,
verses.english: I might encounter youths escaping a crime or on their way to commit one, and they might take my life.

verses.pali: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
verses.english: And if I died from that it would be an obstacle to my progress.

verses.pali: handāhaṁ vīriyaṁ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
verses.english: I’d better rouse up energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.’

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, catutthaṁ anāgatabhayaṁ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
verses.english: This is the fourth future peril …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
verses.english: Furthermore, a wilderness mendicant reflects:

verses.pali: ‘ahaṁ kho etarahi ekako araññe viharāmi.
verses.english: ‘Currently I’m living alone in a wilderness.

verses.pali: Santi kho panāraññe vāḷā amanussā, te maṁ jīvitā voropeyyuṁ,
verses.english: But in a wilderness there are savage monsters who might take my life.

verses.pali: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
verses.english: And if I died from that it would be an obstacle to my progress.

verses.pali: handāhaṁ vīriyaṁ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
verses.english: I’d better rouse up energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.’

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṁ anāgatabhayaṁ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
verses.english: This is the fifth future peril …

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṁ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the five future perils, seeing which is quite enough for a wilderness mendicant to meditate diligently, keenly, and resolutely for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
